name: Dr. B.C. Roy Award
description: The Dr. B.C. Roy National Award was instituted in 1962 by the Medical Council of India and was long regarded as the country's most coveted honour for physicians, recognising eminent medical persons and teachers, the development of specialities, socio-medical relief and research. It is no longer conferred: the last ceremony was held on 28 March 2017, covering the award years 2014 to 2016, and in November 2022 the National Medical Commission formally disassociated itself from the award. A replacement national honour for doctors was reported to be under consideration in 2026 but has not been instituted. A privately awarded "Dr. B.C. Roy Memorial Award" is a different and unrelated prize.
